## CPGQL DSL reference (Joern, Scala) — auto-generated by agent.dslgen.extract
## 33/79 steps kept (58% reduction). See joern_dsl.manual.txt for the hand-authored reference.

### Grammar
```
<query>            ::= <root> <step-chain> "." <terminal>

<root>             ::= "cpg"

<step-chain>       ::= ( "." <step> )*

<step>             ::= <source-step>
                      | <structural-step>
                      | <filter-step>
                      | <repeat-block>
                      | <core-step>

<source-step>      ::= "method" | "call" | "argument" | "parameter" | "identifier"
                      | "literal" | "local" | "member" | "assignment"
                      | "controlStructure" | "file" | "typeDecl" | "source" | "sink" | "all"

<structural-step>  ::= "astParent" | "astChildren" | "astNode"
                      | "callee" | "caller" | "callIn" | "inCall" | "locations"

<filter-step>      ::= <predicate-filter> | <prop-filter> | <type-filter>
<predicate-filter>  ::= "filter" "(" <lambda> ")"
                      | "filterNot" "(" <lambda> ")"
                      | "where" "(" <subtraversal> ")"
                      | "whereNot" "(" <subtraversal> ")"
                      | "and" "(" <subtraversal> ("," <subtraversal>)* ")"
                      | "or"  "(" <subtraversal> ("," <subtraversal>)* ")"
<prop-filter>       ::= "name" "(" <string> ")"
                      | "code" "(" <string> ")"
                      | "isExternal" "(" <bool> ")"
<type-filter>       ::= "isCall" | "isLiteral" | "isIdentifier"
<subtraversal>      ::= "_" "." <step-chain>
<lambda>            ::= "_" "." <field> ( <comparator> <value> )?

<repeat-block>      ::= "repeat" "(" <subtraversal> ")"
                         ( "." "until" "(" <subtraversal> ")"
                         | "." "times" "(" <int> ")" )?
                         ( "." "emit" )?

<core-step>         ::= "map" "(" <lambda> ")" | "clone" | "dedup" | "sideEffect" "(" <lambda> ")"

<taint-query>       ::= <root> "." <sink-clause>
                         "." "reachableByFlows" "(" <source-clause> ")"
                         ( "." <sanitizer-clause> )?
                         "." <terminal>

<sink-clause>       ::= <root> "." <source-step> ( "." <filter-step> )*
<source-clause>     ::= <root> "." <source-step> ( "." <filter-step> )*
<sanitizer-clause>  ::= "whereNot" "(" <subtraversal> ")"
                       | "notControlledBy" "(" <subtraversal> ")"

<terminal>          ::= "toList" | "l" | "toJson" | "toJsonPretty" | "p" | "dump" | "size"
```

### Subset catalog

#### dataflow
- `def controlledBy(condTrav: ...): Traversal[Path]` — Restrict flows to those wrapped by a given AST control condition (e.g. an if-check acting as a sanitizer/guard).
- `def notControlledBy(condTrav: ...): Traversal[Path]` — Restrict flows to those NOT wrapped by a given AST control condition.
- `def reachableBy[A](sourceTrav: IterableOnce[A]*)(implicit ctx: EngineContext): Traversal[CfgNode]` — Filter sink nodes down to those reachable by a data flow from the given sources.
- `def reachableByFlows[A](sourceTrav: IterableOnce[A]*)(implicit ctx: EngineContext): Traversal[Path]` — Find complete data-flow paths from sink(s) back to given source(s).
- `def reachableByPartialFlows[A](sourceTrav: IterableOnce[A]*)(implicit ctx: EngineContext): Traversal[Path]` — MoCQ engine extension: returns taint paths that stalled before reaching a source, for diagnosing a failing reachableByFlows query.

#### filter
- `def and(ps: (Traversal[A] => Traversal[_])*): Traversal[A]` — Filter requiring all of several sub-traversals to be non-empty.
- `def code(pattern: String): Traversal[A]` — Property-filter step restricting to nodes whose CODE property matches.
- `def filter(p: A => Boolean): Traversal[A]` — Keep nodes for which the given predicate returns true.
- `def isExternal(v: Boolean): Traversal[Method]` — Property-filter step restricting methods by their IS_EXTERNAL flag.
- `def name(pattern: String): Traversal[A]` — Property-filter step restricting to nodes whose NAME property matches.
- `def or(ps: (Traversal[A] => Traversal[_])*): Traversal[A]` — Filter requiring at least one of several sub-traversals to be non-empty.
- `def where(p: Traversal[A] => Traversal[_]): Traversal[A]` — Continue only for nodes where the supplied sub-traversal is non-empty.
- `def whereNot(p: Traversal[A] => Traversal[_]): Traversal[A]` — Continue only for nodes where the supplied sub-traversal is empty.

#### other
- `def dedup: Traversal[A]` — Deduplicate results in a traversal.
- `def l: List[A]` — Shorthand for toList.
- `def map[B](f: A => B): Traversal[B]` — Transform each element of the traversal via a function.
- `def size: Int` — Execute the traversal and return the count of results.

#### source
- `cpg.argument: Traversal[Expression]` — All actual arguments (parameters) passed at call sites.
- `cpg.call: Traversal[Call]` — All call sites; typical starting point for sinks/sources by callee name.
- `cpg: Cpg` — Root object referencing the Code Property Graph being queried.
- `cpg.identifier: Traversal[Identifier]` — All identifier occurrences (local variables/members referenced in method bodies).
- `cpg.method: Traversal[Method]` — All method/function/procedure declarations, including external stubs.
- `cpg.parameter: Traversal[MethodParameterIn]` — All formal parameters of methods.
- `def sink: Traversal[CfgNode]` — Nodes pre-identified as sensitive sinks for taint-tracking.
- `def source: Traversal[CfgNode]` — Nodes pre-identified as sensitive/attacker-controlled sources for taint-tracking.

#### structural
- `def astChildren: Traversal[AstNode]` — Move to the immediate AST child nodes.
- `def astNode: AstNode` — Convert a CFG/data-flow node to its nearest AST node.
- `def astParent: Traversal[AstNode]` — Move to the immediate AST parent node.
- `def callIn: Traversal[Call]` — Call-graph parent call-sites of the traversed methods.
- `def callee: Traversal[Method]` — Call-graph callees of the traversed call sites.
- `def caller: Traversal[Method]` — Call-graph callers of the traversed methods.
- `def inCall: Traversal[Call]` — Surrounding call-graph call-sites of the traversed nodes (e.g. argument -> enclosing call).
- `def locations: Traversal[NewLocation]` — All locations of nodes traversed in a given data-flow path.
